'''Sharlotta''' is a [[Darkfriend]] [[wilder]].
== Activities ==
She is given orders to join the [[Black Ajah]] mission on the road to [[Tar Valon]] after the capture of [[Rand al'Thor]] by the loyalist [[Aes Sedai]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
